candidates.event_date: 2026-10-01 (Thursday evening inferred from publication dated Oct 2)
candidates.description: Amnesty International candlelight campaign/mobilization at Limete interchange, Kinshasa, described as memorial/solidarity; classification as protest uncertain.

Road blockages/protest at three locations; demonstrators in Río Hondo sought respect for right to community consultation; local article also says military veterans organized a blockage in San Lucas Sacatepéquez.

Protest sit-in/public reading at Piazza Montecitorio against proposed antisemitism bill; post-event outlet says artists and associations joined the protest and reports dissent in multiple other cities.

Vilnius migration-related protest/counterprotest cluster: several hundred at anti-immigration protest, over one hundred at counterprotest, and dozens at separate anti-hate action; corroborated by LRT and 15min/BNS.

Residents in Saint-Paul, Allée-Brillant, Highlands, and Clairfonds No. 1 protested prolonged water cuts; sources report road blockades and burning tires/mattresses. Discovery candidate; final classification awaits kit.
OTEP-SN teachers marched on the Asunción Costanera toward MEC over workload, bureaucracy, funding, school closures; ABC post-event reporting says police blocked access. Attendance not captured.
Encarnación municipal workers (about 100 per La Tribuna) assembled, briefly obstructed traffic and held a sit-in for unpaid salaries/benefits; ABC independently reported the protest.
Around 300 people protested in Lisbon against planned visit of US Secretary of State Marco Rubio; march began 18:00 at Largo de São Domingos, organized by CPPC.

candidates.event_date: 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 possibly (strike reported active into fourth week on Oct 9)
candidates.description: Public university lecturers' indefinite UASA strike was declared Sep 16 and was reported Oct 9 as entering its fourth week, with public universities largely shut since mid-September. Candidate only if ongoing labor actions count; strike began before scope.

Housing demonstrations were reported in 50+ cities. Madrid march columns converged at Cibeles; official estimate 70,000 and organizer claim 500,000. Valencia and other city actions also reported; same underlying mobilization may be covered by both outlets.
Around 100 LGBTQ+ community members protested in Taipei after police raided a gay bar on Oct 3; Reuters reported a march to a precinct police station. Follow-up coverage is same event.

Approximately 500 AGC Display Glass workers reportedly carried out a three-day strike and picket line in Douliu, Yunlin County, beginning Oct 5. Newtalk previewed the action on Oct 1; WSWS described the completed three-day action Oct 7.

Approximately 350 people gathered in Gosport, Hampshire, to protest arrival of migrants by small boat; Reuters says police arrested 12 after a public-order incident, with ITV reporting the same event.

Student pro-Palestinian demonstrations in London and university demonstrations in Edinburgh and Glasgow; Guardian reports 11 arrests across London and other protests, Independent gives London event detail. Count/deduplication needs screening.
